title: Warm job builds with a shared sccache, keeping per-job target dirs
summary: Keep D46's per-job CARGO_TARGET_DIR (so cargo freshness never crosses jobs) but add sccache, the content-addressed compiler cache D46 named as alternative (c), via RUSTC_WRAPPER and a shared SCCACHE_DIR in athena.toml. Record the call as a new decision that amends D46 and update the design text that says every job builds cold.

defaults_applied.how: Use sccache rather than building a custom cache.
Isolation stays enforced by check_build_dirs; the cache is safe because it is content-keyed.
The new decision cites D46 and review 2's R14, and labels speed gains as estimates.
cargo test, clippy and fmt must stay clean.
Config and decision record first; code edits only if pass-through requires them.

assumptions: Adopting sccache (D46's alternative c) is the intended route, since the user wants warm builds and isolation and D46 said it was deferred until cold builds dominate; the user's ~165s figure meets that condition.
The cache location is shared by all jobs on the machine, e.g. a directory under the Athena state dir or a path from the user's environment, passed through to agents.
sccache is installed by setup or by the user; if it is absent, builds must still work (cold) rather than fail, so the wrapper must degrade gracefully or setup must install and check it.
The speedup cannot be measured by the verifier's allowed commands, so the change claims it only as an estimate.
question: Is sccache (with a cache shared across jobs) acceptable, given it is a new external tool that must be installed?

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml [capabilities.change.env] still sets CARGO_TARGET_DIR to {job_dir}/target/{side}, and adds RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache plus a SCCACHE_DIR shared across jobs (outside any job directory); athena.toml is named as changed.

docs/decisions.md gains a new decision that amends D46: it records why a content-addressed cache keeps isolation (outputs keyed by content, not mtimes, so R14 cannot recur), the alternatives (persistent shared target dirs, seeding a target copy), and the buy-first call for sccache.

Any environment pass-through needed (e.g. SCCACHE_DIR in env_pass_if_set) is added, and the design text claiming nothing is shared and every job builds cold (§10.4, M26, risk table) is updated to match.
Run `cargo test` from the repository root: all tests pass, including env.rs tests that parse athena.toml and the check that build dirs lie inside the job directory, and xtask policy tests.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`: both clean.
No per-job build directory is made shared: check_build_dirs still refuses a CARGO_TARGET_DIR outside the job's directory.

out_of_scope: Changing the study capability's behavior beyond mirroring env if appropriate
departures: Slightly lower acceptance and pass odds: it reverses a user decision (D46), adds an external tool, and the speedup cannot be verified with the allowed commands.
